title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：shower　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shower 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the grandmother ① took the shower that no child in the courtyard would have noted, and he said the taking was the whole of the year. The ② shower, meaning the rain itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a shower, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ shower in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ shower at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shower, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the grandmother said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shower was the whole of the matter, meaning the refreshment and not the rain. The ⑥ shower, meaning the refreshment and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; shower, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both a rain and a refreshment. He said the refreshment is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ shower had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ shower of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of noting; shower, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shower I remember is the rain noted in the diary, which closed in 1973 and is still noted as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ shower, my mother said in 1975, is the only rain that improves by being noted; every shower, she said, is a refreshment that has agreed to look like a rain. She said the refreshment was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 淋浴；阵雨（指院子里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 淋浴；阵雨（指那场淋浴本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the shower 冲这一场淋浴
D. n. 淋浴；阵雨（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 淋浴之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的淋浴之事）
F. n. 淋浴；阵雨（指日记里写到、被记下的那一场）
G. n. 淋浴、清爽（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 清爽（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the shower that no child in the courtyard would have noted
The shower, meaning the rain itself and not the lamp
the shower at the far window
the shower was the whole of the matter
the shower had become a line in a diary
The shower of the whole thing
A shower, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: take the shower 意为“冲这一场淋浴”，1966 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯记下的一场淋浴做了一遍。
shower 意为“淋浴；阵雨”，指那场淋浴本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
shower 意为“淋浴；阵雨”，指院子里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
shower 意为“淋浴；阵雨”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shower 意为“淋浴、清爽”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场清爽就是那件事的全部。
shower 意为“清爽”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场淋浴，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shower 意为“淋浴；阵雨”，指日记里写到、被记下的那一场，到 1971 年这一场成了日记里的一行。
shower 意为“淋浴之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的淋浴之事是一处院子和三个年头的记下。
shower 意为“淋浴；阵雨”，我记得的是日记里记下过的那一场，1973 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一场。
shower 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，淋浴是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的淋浴。
